notes.title: Proto-G
notes.content:
[img]https://api.pcloud.com/getpubthumb?code=XZ8vuG7ZsnpxA7O8ulJFKd2ap9mduXI3m5DV&linkpassword=undefined&size=1280x720&crop=0&type=auto[/img]

Introducing Proto-G, a hack and slash platformer and puzzle semi openworld game piece that we excited to show you. Proto-G has taken a different perspective on future world of humanity where in the game you can determine in non-linear way. Expect awesome cities to explore and tough bosses along the way.

[b]Release date will announced in the near future[/b]

contact us at and we will invite you to proto-g beta testers discord group

notes.title: Its going to take longer..
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello [/h1][/b]
If you already know about Proto-G, we have something to tell you.. 
As most development faces challenges and obstacles, we felt sorry that Proto-G [b]might not be able to finish in 2019[/b] ːsteamsadː due to budget and monetary reasons. Some factors that we cannot control is taking tolls to overall team morale and operations in business aspects. If things going better in couple months, we will fulfill our schedule as to release in timely manner. We hope that your interest in Proto-G does not fade as we are not and we will make sure to deliver great game worth of your time and resource.

notes.title: Demo Updates
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We want to announce that Proto-G had some changes to the game.

- Bug fixes
- Subtitle and audio adjustment
- Combat balancing and adjustment
- UI updates
- Game options updates

We also wanted to say thanks to all of beta testers for reaching us out to make Proto-G better.

We have more things for you that we will publish in Demo build. Stay tune!

notes.title: Demo Coming Soon, Stay tune!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33900116/4455c652e23296de24bc13a16d8837156c5c2c97.jpg[/img]

Since ICC 2018 ([i]Indonesia Comic-Con[/i]) held in Jakarta, 28th October 2018. We are overflowed with feedbacks from many players who are passionate and interested in Proto-G. This makes us so happy and excited.

As Result, these past weeks we have been fixing, polishing, rethink, and group feedbacks and turned that into a worthy demo to be played. As we really care about player's experiences when they first play Proto-G.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33900116/4267bceacbf6b3aa282133e3853c4043551dac6d.jpg[/img]

While our [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/proto-g-a-futuristic-robot-hack-and-slash-pc-game/x/19346135]indiegogo[/url] campaign still going, we decided to focus our limited resources on making the demo free of bugs, fluid and most of all asset qualities. 

While not all part of Proto-G can satisfy everyone, we want to provide path where your feedbacks matters in this development. Reach us and talk to us of any dissatisfaction you found while playing Proto-G.

[b]Let us make Proto-G a great game for all, and stay tune![/b]
